name: Jehdeiah
overview: Jehdeiah is a male member of the tribe of Levi, uniquely identified as the son of Shebuel, grandson of Gershom, and great-grandson of Moses. His lineage places him within the priestly family descending from Moses, highlighting his heritage within the Levitical priesthood. There are no additional notes recorded about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Jehdeiah means 'y-h-v-h rejoices [in his works],' reflecting a theologically rich meaning connected to the LORD's joy in His deeds. This proper name is not indicated as given directly by God, but it reveals a relationship of divine rejoicing associated with the individual.
familyAndRelationships: Jehdeiah is explicitly recorded as the son of Shebuel, establishing a clear father-son relationship within a notable priestly lineage. Beyond this, Scripture does not provide further family relationships for Jehdeiah beyond what is noted in his unique ancestral line.
scriptureSignificance: Jehdeiah's significance in Scripture stems from his direct descent from Moses through Gershom and Shebuel, marking him as part of the Levitical priestly line. This genealogical detail underscores the continuity of priestly service and God's covenantal faithfulness through Moses' descendants. His mention in 1 Chronicles 24:20 situates him within the organization of the priestly divisions, which played a vital role in temple worship and the spiritual life of Israel.
